The claim states that NeRF Initialization Strategies address slow convergence and instability by using specific methods (implied by the context of the evidence) to improve training. This directly supports the assertion that the strategy addresses slow convergence (by reducing epochs/time) and implies improved stability/efficiency compared to random initialization, which requires significantly more resources and time.
